description:
XrmToolBox tool. Connect to the environment the data came from (primary) and the one it was migrated to
      (secondary), pick an entity and one of its views, and Data Compare reads every record of the view in both
      environments, matches them on their GUID and shows each one coloured: missing from the secondary (red),
      present in both but with at least one different column (amber), identical (green), or only in the
      secondary (blue). Every attribute of the entity is compared, except an editable list of ignored audit, owner
      and currency columns; selecting a record shows each column side by side with the differences highlighted.
      Dataverse online and Dynamics 365 on-premises 9.x. Read-only: nothing is ever written to either environment.
releaseNotes:
1.2026.10.2 - Entity mappings: compare an entity with a differently named table in the secondary (data
      migrated into another table), with optional column pairs for columns that were renamed; the view is
      rewritten for the secondary table, and the records are still matched on their GUID. Compare options...
      replaces Ignored attributes... and adds a prefix filter: compare only the columns whose names start with
      given prefixes (e.g. contoso_, new_). The detail pane gets a column search: show only the columns whose
      logical or display name contains the text, kept from row to row. The results grid gets a Differing
      column filter: choose a column (listed with how many rows it differs in) to see only the records where it
      differs, together with the status and text filters.
      1.2026.10.1 - first release.
summary: Compares the records of a view between two Dataverse / Dynamics 365 environments after a migration: missing, extra and different records, column by column.
title: Data Compare
